::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 13th 1891  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 22
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)
Many thanks for the [Cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd)- I understand it as £40 for the half year’s editorship, and £10 for the subeditor - [Miss Finlaison](people/person_512.qmd).

The Christmas no for which I have always had £10 for Editorship, stands I suppose upon a different foot. I believe I sent you all the addresses. I had a letter from my cousin

[Miss Crawley Boevey](people/person_381.qmd)[^1]
Flaxley Cottage, Newnham
Gloucestershire,

asking me about it

I think everyone will rejoice if you can make the wrapper more blue

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY was related to the Crawley Boeveys through her paternal grandmother Catharina Crawley.  Sybella Crawley Boevey (d. 1911), daughter of CMY’s second cousin Sir Thomas Crawley-Boevey, 4th Bt., had contributed 'A Love picture in three strokes' *MP* (Christmas 1890), 234-45.
